agentChat.ariaLabel: Chat with your agents from anywhere
agentChat.description: Your AURA agents are always on. Pick up a conversation on your phone, your laptop, or your desktop. They remember everything and bring the same tools with them.

alwaysOn.description: Your agent works around the clock, even while your devices are off.
alwaysOn.title: Always on.

isolated.description: Each agent runs in its own sandboxed VM, fully sealed off from your system and other agents.
isolated.title: Isolated by default.

verifiable.description: Every environment is attested before it runs, so you can always verify what you're trusting.
verifiable.title: Trusted and verifiable.

builtForTrust.headline: Built for trust.
builtForTrust.subhead: AURA agents run in isolated virtual machines within trusted execution environments.

expertise.headline: Expertise without ego.
expertise.subheadLine1: AURA agents are experts in every discipline.
expertise.subheadLine2: From coding to science to creativity.

madeForYou.headline: Agents made for you.
madeForYou.subhead: Design and launch your agent in 30 seconds.

alwaysOn.description: Ask or direct your agent to do almost anything. It will get to work and report back when necessary.
alwaysOn.title: Always on.

connected.description: AURA securely connects to your services so it knows everything about you. Your data never leaves your own secure computer and is never trained on.
connected.title: Connected to everything.

domains.description: Your agent is a genius in all domains. It can help with the simple tasks of life, to creative projects, to advanced design and coding.
domains.title: Intelligent in all domains.

personalAgent.headline: Every model. Every mode.
personalAgent.subhead: AURA is your own personal agent that supports you with everything from light tasks to deep work.

openSource.description: AURA is 100% open source under the MIT license. Fork it anytime, with zero vendor lock-in and no strings attached.
openSource.title: Open Source

private.description: AURA never views or trains on your personal or corporate data. Anything sent to frontier models stays unidentifiable.
private.title: Private

verifiable.description: The AURA harness and kernel are built from the ground up with security, verification, and policy as first-class citizens.
verifiable.title: Verifiable

support.body: Need help with AURA? We’re here for you. Email our support team and we’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
